executive_summary.msft_a304_reconciled_root_cause: Confirmed extraction blind spot (structure_extractor.py requires >=2 factors per claim; claim:82 has only 1). extraction_language_audit.could_trigger_may_trigger_can_trigger: 'trigger'/'triggers'/'triggering' ARE already recognized FORWARD_CAUSAL_VERBs in relation_grammar.py -- the causal-verb detection layer is NOT the gap.
extraction_language_audit.could_cause_may_cause: Not individually re-tested; 'cause' family verbs follow the same FORWARD_CAUSAL_VERB pattern-matching mechanism and are expected to behave analogously (not the source of the gap).
extraction_language_audit.could_pressure: Present in other corpus claims (e.g. TSM's 'would directly pressure the thesis') -- same causal-detection layer, not separately gapped.
extraction_language_audit.slowdown: NOT present as any FACTOR_ALIASES entry under any category -- this is the actual missing piece.
extraction_language_audit.compression: Present via 'multiple compression' under the Valuation Risk factor -- correctly recognized.
extraction_language_audit.why_claim_82_was_missed: structure_extractor.py::_extract_edges() requires len(factors) >= 2 to form ANY edge (a source and a target factor node are both required). claim:82 produces exactly ONE recognized factor (Valuation Risk). No FACTOR_ALIASES phrase matches 'slowdown in Azure growth' as a second, growth-adjacent factor.
extraction_language_audit.classification: CONCEPT_NORMALIZATION_GAP (the 'growth slowdown' concept has no canonical factor representation) COMPOUNDED BY TOKENIZATION_GAP (term_in_text is literal-adjacent-phrase-only; 'slowdown in Azure growth' has the two relevant words in NON-adjacent order, which no literal phrase alias can represent).

negation_aware_requirement.positive_fixture: 'Any slowdown in Azure growth could trigger multiple compression.' -- should extract growth-slowdown --causal--> valuation-risk/compression.
negation_aware_requirement.negative_fixture: 'This is not a slowdown scenario.' -- should NOT tag any growth-slowdown factor, and must not produce any edge.
additional_corpus_patterns_to_handle: risk of slowdown (descriptive, no target concept -- should NOT auto-edge)
slowdown could trigger compression (the clean positive case)
negation_aware_requirement.minimum_safe_language_model_required: A clause-scoped negation detector (does a negation marker -- not/no/unlikely/avoid -- appear between the sentence start/clause boundary and the growth-slowdown anchor, or between the anchor and the causal verb) COMBINED WITH a non-adjacent-phrase-aware source-concept matcher (regex or token-window search for 'slowdown' co-occurring with a growth/spending/capex noun within N tokens, not requiring exact adjacency) COMBINED WITH continued reliance on the EXISTING, already-sufficient causal-verb detector for the predicate. All three pieces are required together; any one alone is unsafe (verified: adjacency-only literal phrase misses the real examples; a bare keyword without negation-awareness misfires on the found negative example).

discrepancy_b_msft_a304.reasoning: A narrow deterministic grammar CANNOT yet reliably distinguish positive causal / negative causal / negated premise / negated consequence / risk-only-descriptive with the tools that exist today (literal-phrase FACTOR_ALIASES matching has no regex or negation capability at all). This is explicitly NOT a simple phrase alias -- Section 21's bar for READY_FOR_BOUNDED_IMPLEMENTATION is not met.

priority_recommendation.label: MSFT negation-aware structure extraction design
priority_recommendation.reasoning: Weighed against correctness, recoverability, blast radius, Gold strength, and ability to prove improvement (explicitly NOT chosen for score gain alone): NEXT_A (Provider research for the three A102 STRONG_GOLD targets) has the highest Gold-quality targets but is entirely Provider-facing, requires separate authorization, and success is inherently uncertain even with better prompts. NEXT_B (QQQ ETF evidence-model design) has low leverage -- the counterfactual shows even 2 new facts don't cross 50, and QQQ A101 is only MEDIUM-confidence/thematic-risk-flagged Gold. NEXT_C (SNDK structure recovery) is a DEAD END -- this task found NO legitimate structure omission exists for either SNDK A103 or A301; pursuing it further would mean either fabricating credit or relaxing rules, both forbidden. NEXT_E (fresh Provider run for TSM A301) is a single, non-deterministic retry with no generalizable value beyond this one case. NEXT_D is uniquely attractive: it is the ONLY track addressing a demonstrated, CODE-side correctness gap (not a research-acquisition uncertainty), it is fully designable and testable OFFLINE via replay of already-persisted claims (no Provider dependency to validate progress), and the underlying 'slowdown in [X] growth/spending/capex -> trigger -> compression' pattern recurs across 4 of 6 tickers -- meaning a properly-designed fix has value well beyond the single MSFT A304 hit. NEXT_F (no implementation) is not chosen because a concrete, bounded next design step (the negation-aware grammar sketched in Section 20) has already been identified and is ready for scoping.
